title: CodeEdit - `symbol_validate` signal not emitted
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in 4.5.1.stable

### System information

Godot v4.5.1.stable unknown - Arch Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Fri, 14 Nov 2025 06:54:20 +0000 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Single-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+)

### Issue description

`CodeEdit` class doesn't emit `symbol_validate` signal when the mouse hovers over a symbol. `symbol_lookup_on_click` is enabled as prerequisite.

When using the MRP described below, `symbol_hovered` works as expected and a debug print shows that `symbol_lookup_on_click` is enabled but no `symbol_validate` signal is emitted.

### Steps to reproduce

- enable `symbol_lookup_on_click`
- connect `symbol_validate` signal to `on_symbol_validate` function in main script
- for debug purpose, also enable `symbol_hovered` and define the connected functions as follows:
```gdscript
# Emitted when the user hovers over a symbol. 
func _on_symbol_hovered(symbol: String, line: int, column: int) -> void:
	print("DEBUG: symbol_lookup_on_click = ", symbol_lookup_on_click)
	print("SYMBOL HOVERED: ", symbol, " at line ", line)

# Emitted when the user hovers over a symbol. The symbol should be validated and responded to, by calling set_symbol_lookup_word_as_valid().
# Note: symbol_lookup_on_click must be true for this signal to be emitted.
func _on_symbol_validate(symbol: String) -> void:
	print("SYMBOL TO VALIDATE: ", symbol)
	if symbol == "World":
		set_symbol_lookup_word_as_valid(true)
	else: set_symbol_lookup_word_as_valid(false)

# Emitted when the user has clicked on a valid symbol.
func _on_symbol_lookup(symbol: String, line: int, column: int) -> void:
	print("SYMBOL LOOKUP: ", symbol, " at line ", line)
```
Output terminal shows the following when "World" symbol is hovered on:
```
DEBUG: symbol_lookup_on_click = true
SYMBOL HOVERED: World at line 0
```

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[code-edit-debug.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/23692467/code-edit-debug.zip)
